top_creatures.label: Elemental wyrm
top_creatures.why: winged giant quadruped, one element per body, breath as a signature spell, flat early-depth population (weight 295, depths 0-5)
top_creatures.keep: winged quadruped silhouette, one element per colour, breath spell with a clear telegraph
top_creatures.change: body proportions (not a dragon), element set, breath shape and timing

top_creatures.label: Bone wyrm
top_creatures.why: undead tag on a giant flyer reads as a skeleton at a glance
top_creatures.keep: undead holiness, winged silhouette, large size
top_creatures.change: no see-invisible requirement, our own bone pattern and wing build

top_creatures.label: Hollow sovereign
top_creatures.why: undead caster whose will is set to invulnerable, a clean damage-check boss read
top_creatures.keep: undead caster, mind-proof will, speech on alert
top_creatures.change: our own abilities and silhouette (robes to armour)

top_creatures.label: Clan of eight drakes
top_creatures.why: one body in eight colour variants, each with one breath type given as a fake mutation
top_creatures.keep: palette plus one trait per variant
top_creatures.change: our breath types, clan names, per-clan silhouettes

top_creatures.label: Iron warden
top_creatures.why: six ironbound variants each carry a different spell set, so one construct body reads as several roles
top_creatures.keep: construct silhouette, one role per variant
top_creatures.change: our crafting flavour and spell names

top_creatures.label: Shard elemental
top_creatures.why: four elemental crystal forms; the fire form is flagged unblindable and avatar (other flags not checked)
top_creatures.keep: one crystal identity per element; unblindable
top_creatures.change: faceted shard shape (not a face), our element palette

top_creatures.label: Hydra of the mere
top_creatures.why: unique boss with the tall_tile flag (17 files carry it), fast regeneration
top_creatures.keep: tall boss frame; regeneration as pressure
top_creatures.change: head count, regen rule (for example regen stops while hit), frame size

top_creatures.label: Rolling ember
top_creatures.why: orb shape with projectile and insubstantial flags, random sprite variance, no threat flag: reads as a hazard, not a target
top_creatures.keep: ball silhouette that is a hazard; random tile variance
top_creatures.change: our telegraph and colour (no copy of the orb art)

classes: Warrior: Brigand (fighting, dodging, stealth, throwing, weapon); Fighter (armour, shields); Gladiator (fighting, throwing, dodging, weapon); Hunter (stealth, weapon); Monk (dodging, weapon). Skill-led, no spells.
Zealot: Berserker (fighting, weapon, dodging); Chaos Knight (armour, weapon); Cinder Acolyte (fire skill, scorch spell).
Adventurer: Artificer (evocations, armour); Delver (stealth, weapon); Wanderer (no skills listed).

Mage: Air, Earth, Fire and Ice Elementalists (element conjurations and spells); Alchemist (poison and sticky-flame spells); Conjurer (magic dart, searing ray, prism); Forgewright (grapnel, spike launcher, clockwork bee, golem and lightning-spire spells); Hedge Wizard (blink, imp call, grave claw, cloud); Necromancer (soul splinter, grave claw, drain, animate dead, agony curse); Summoner (summons: mammal, imp, familiar, crocodile, seismosaurus egg).

Warrior-mage: Enchanter (hibernation, confusing touch, dance, gloom); Hexslinger (jinxbite, sigil of binding, cause fear, bullseye); Reaver (kiss of death, momentum strike, hailstorm, rending blade); Warper (blink, beckoning, teleport other, piledriver, electric charge).
Metamorph: Mystic (fire, earth, air, ice and shapeshifting skills; ice thorns, sirocco, dragon veins); Shapeshifter (unarmed, shapeshifting); Stalker (stealth, shapeshifting, weapon).
Species (35): difficulty Simple 9, Intermediate 9, Advanced 9, draconian colour variants 8 with no tier; mutations in 43 species files; each draconian colour adds one breath as a fake mutation.

looks.label: Per-cell animated element colour
looks.technique: colour is a function of position and time, not a texture: waves band moves with turn count mod 20; disjunction is a radial swirl phase; orb glow is a ring rippling outward from the player (bit 4 of frame minus 2/3 distance)

looks.label: Hashed colour variance
looks.technique: per-cell colour seeded from birth time, position, frame and depth, so random looks stay stable across frames

looks.label: Four-phase elemental cycle
looks.technique: earth, air or lightning, magma, ice, changing every 200 elapsed units

looks.label: Milestone colour ladder
looks.technique: one item colour climbs bone, shimmer blue, magic, flash, jewel at 1, 3, 9 and 27 completed milestones

looks.label: Aura refresh
looks.technique: a short status is re-set each tick and overrides a shorter one rather than stacking; hostile auras stop when the source is in a sanctuary; phalanx barrier is adjacent-only and protects only its summoner

looks.label: Tile variance as idle motion
looks.technique: 52 monster files set tile_variance to cycle, mod, random or water

looks.label: Tall boss frame
looks.technique: 17 monsters carry tall_tile so bosses read as bigger on a 32-pixel grid

originals.name: Scale Ladder
originals.idea: a ten-tier scale set where AC rises, evasion falls, and each tier carries one property
originals.keep: AC up, evasion down, one property per tier
originals.change: our tier names, property set, price curve, a visible tier bump on the hero

originals.name: Milestone Relic
originals.idea: an item whose colour steps up as zones are cleared
originals.change: our milestones (zone clears, bosses), our palette, a sound cue per step

originals.name: Ripple Ward
originals.idea: a relic that pulses in rings outward from the hero
originals.keep: phase delayed by distance so the pulse travels
originals.change: 3D rings sized for 375 px; a slower pulse in calm states

originals.name: Clan of Breath
originals.idea: one humanoid body in several colour clans, each with one breath element
originals.change: our elements, per-clan silhouettes, our breath telegraph

originals.name: Depth Table
originals.idea: per-zone encounter tables with FLAT, SEMI, PEAK, RISE and FALL weights per monster
originals.keep: distribution shapes per monster and depth
originals.change: our weights and zone fields (cap, respawn, grace); parity row 23

originals.name: Halo Sight
originals.idea: a see-through halo at the hero so occluders fade near the hero
originals.keep: radial alpha falloff and a radius cap
originals.change: elliptical iso falloff and a fade time tuned for the fight camera (row 11)

originals.name: Palette Dye
originals.idea: recolour gear by the red channel into a palette, with a grey-only hue mode and a ghost mode
originals.keep: one shader, grey-only hue, ghost mode
originals.change: our palette and ghost look (crossuo shader reference, not crawl)

originals.name: Refresh Aura
originals.idea: a boss aura that refreshes rather than stacks, suppressed in a safe zone
originals.change: our aura radius, safe-zone rule and status names
